sentences.en: Those gloom and doom economists aren't worth their salt.
sentences.zh: 那些唱衰论调的经济学家根本不值一文。

sentences.en: Economists have predicted five of the last three recessions.
sentences.zh: 经济学家预测了最近三次衰退中的五次。（意指他们经常错误地预测经济情况）

sentences.en: He's a chief economist at an Algerian research institute.
sentences.zh: 他是一名阿尔及利亚研究机构的首席经济学家。

senses.zh: 经济学家，经济专家；节俭的人
